scope: Pancreatic cancer cell survival under abnormal cell division, with functional evidence on division machinery, nutrient use, redox and protein stress, and tumor–stromal signaling. Mechanistic studies in other cell models provide transferable hypotheses whose context must be checked.
research_prompt: Which overlooked, potentially targetable dependencies allow pancreatic tumor cells to keep dividing despite abnormal division machinery? Prioritize mechanisms connecting cellular metabolism or the local environment to division fidelity, and propose computational tests that distinguish these mechanisms from general growth inhibition.
